name: Kouguchi Rinko
source: Rinko is 2 years older than her husband Sukebei. She loves her husband unconditionally, she fell in love with him at first sight in high school and her feelings for him have only increased day by day. Rinko has an almost insatiable sexual appetite and is willing to indulge him with whatever fantasy she wants, as long as only the two of them are involved. She LOVES to be creampied by her husband.
